# Recorded pager retirement map

Status: **Not done**. Source review is complete. The semantic replacement is
present in the current native owners and the frozen four-test patch. The parent
must run the named tests before removal. This review ran no Cargo command.

The reviewed four-test patch is
[native-recorded-gates.patch](/tmp/araphor-native-recorded-gates-20261020-m9mfq8a0/native-recorded-gates.patch),
SHA256 `1430eb7ffd9b87e66306a17d9b4089b780c730237bac32c791e0fbe7cad8f928`.
The source hashes are in [source-map.json](source-map.json).

## Owner change

[RecordedPages::new](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages.rs:36) The old owner validates one manifest and builds sorted record groups.
-> [RecordGroup::read](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages.rs:122) The old owner keeps duplicate records, contexts, and exclusions in one group.
-> [CoveragePage::slice](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages.rs:249) The old owner splits declared coverage counts across artificial pages.
-> [RecordedPages::page](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages.rs:59) The old owner copies selected rows and adjusts intermediate lifecycle references.

[Query common capture](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-query/src/sources/rows.rs:343) The native owner captures complete selected Arrow relations and their source receipt.
-> [Native recorded SQL](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis-builtins/src/discovery/sql/recorded_snapshot.sql:1) Native operators group all partitions, preserve declared ranges, and compute one complete result.
-> [DiscoveryOwner::recorded_result](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis/src/discovery/output.rs:15) The host checks exact call identity, schemas, source attribution, and complete result proof.
-> [DiscoveryInputManifestV1::validate_result](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-data/src/discovery/validation/recorded.rs:4) Data checks accounting, exclusions, atom sources, coverage, and lifecycle.

The complete computation has no recorded pager or page-size option. Arrow
batches and native partitions do not create separate discovery executions.
The fixed 128-group split, intermediate cursor fragments, intermediate Missing
lifecycle states, and zero page-size error leave with that internal API.

## All old test assertions

| Old test in `pages/tests.rs` | Native proof or intentional removal |
| --- | --- |
| `sparse_expected_keeps_capacity` | `recorded_sparse_counts_survive` keeps the complete 1..10000 range, declared total 10000, revision, interval, stream, CPU, and prior reason. Complete final computation marks the two-record range GAPPED. The old 9999/1 intermediate split is removed transport. |
| `expected_preserves_mismatches` | The same new test uses expected counts 0/1/2/3/10000. It preserves each declared total. Only matching count 2 avoids INPUT_RANGE_INCOMPLETE. Fragment adjacency and per-fragment capacity checks leave with `CoveragePage::slice`. |
| `multiple_empty_ranges_survive` | `recorded_preserves_empty_ranges` keeps all three range identities once, including the coverage-only CPU range. Reversed records and ranges pass through split native tables. The final empty range is GAPPED, as the old guest computation required after raw page slicing. |
| `duplicate_groups_stay_together` | `recorded_snapshot_matches_oracle` checks duplicates and context identity across reversed partitions. `recorded_crosses_old_boundary` checks the complete 129-record duplicate count, exclusion, unresolved row, evidence order, lifecycle references, and metadata. `duplicates_keep_context_projection` checks 1024 projected duplicates with large escaped context. Per-page record/context/exclusion copy counts are removed transport; native aggregation sees the complete relation. |
| `orphan_rows_are_rejected` | `recorded_rejects_relational_conflicts` rejects both orphan contexts and orphan exclusions. The Builtins `record_pages_keep_proof` test retains typed orphan-context and record-range errors. Data retains manifest/source validation. Pager-specific error construction leaves with the private constructor. |
| `lifecycle_refs_follow_pages` | `recorded_snapshot_matches_oracle` compares complete Recorded, Declared, NotApplicable, Unsupported, and default Missing states across native partitions. `recorded_crosses_old_boundary` retains Startup references 1 and 129 exactly. No intermediate per-page Missing state is exposed. |
| `empty_input_yields_page` | `recorded_empty_and_coverage` compares the complete empty native snapshot with the trusted oracle. The result exists even without records or ranges. A one-page iterator shape is removed transport. |
| `empty_records_keep_range` | `recorded_preserves_empty_ranges` then removes all records and contexts. Each of the three declared ranges remains once with exact identity, revision, interval, expected count, and final incomplete qualification. |
| `cancellation_stops_iteration` | `cancel_joins_source_read` holds an actual native read, cancels it, proves join before return, checks Cancelled, then checks end of stream. `subscription_cancel_joins_capture` and `subscription_cancel_joins_worker` also check real worker joins and permit/memory release. The old pager iterator is removed. |
| `zero_size_is_rejected` | The native path has no recorded page-size parameter. Remove this internal transport assertion with that API. Do not add another pager option or fixed cap. |

## Source and test route

- [Native complete and partition tests](/home/navid/go/src/github.com/Ereborlabs/erebor-runtime/crates/araphor-analysis/src/package/tests/sql/recorded.rs:794)

No missing pager semantic rule was found in this bounded review. This statement

# Independent recorded-leaf review

Verdict: The complete finite behavior in atoms.rs and pages.rs has a current
native owner and assertion route. No additional production gap was found.
Retirement is conditional on compilation and all named tests on the exact
integrated source. This reviewer ran no Cargo command or test.

The exact four candidate files are:

- `crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/atoms.rs`: 163 production lines.
- `crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages.rs`: 281 production lines.
- `crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/atoms/tests.rs`: eight pure finite tests, zero production lines.
- `crates/araphor-analysis_back/src/discovery/sdk/pages/tests.rs`: ten finite/transport tests, zero production lines.

All four files still match baseline 6a25 byte for byte. Source hashes are in
source-map.json. The current native test source now matches the exact AFTER
hash of patch dd4d2d65. This proves integration, not a passing test.

## Complete function map

| Old functions | Current owner and retained rule |
| --- | --- |
| atoms derive_recorded / derive_page | One admitted PackageCall consumes complete inputs under one captured cut and pinned image. Complete SDK returns are sealed. Analysis recorded_result checks call identity, tenant, schemas and source. Data validates independent input-to-output provenance. Duplicate totals, dispositions, coverage and lifecycle do not pass through artificial 128-group executions and merges. |
| observation | durable_record_projection accepts real frames into Data, queries the actual events provider with native SQL, and compares the full normalized Record batch with wire-derived expected rows. It preserves every old field, original bytes, source lifetime, UInt64 MAX sequence/file object, exhaustion and witness assertions. |
| context / atom_key | Native recorded SQL creates keys from complete typed joins. Data source_atom_key independently checks source, record/context lifetime, operation, generation, interval and proof kind. Current forged-output tests preserve exact identity, physical-result, lifecycle and coverage rejection. context_content_changes_revision checks actual input hashing with source/store metadata fixed. |
| RecordedPages new / page / next | Data manifest/record validation, native SQL relational guards and current immutable output proof retain complete valid inputs and source metadata. Native stream execution returns a complete result or typed error and exhaustion. Current cancellation tests hold real source/guest workers, require join before return, and check permit/memory release. |
| RecordGroup read / copy_to | Native DISTINCT/window/aggregate operators process all partitions and reject conflicting bytes/context/exclusion values. Data unique_rows retains source accounting and evidence. Current 129/1024 tests preserve complete duplicate and boundary assertions. |
| CoveragePage read / contains / slice | Native joins retain full stream/CPU/cursor/interval membership and reject orphan/outside/overlap inputs. Sparse counts and coverage-only ranges retain exact revision, interval and reasons. Declared totals are conserved without fragment allocation. |
| lifecycle | Native full lifecycle aggregation retains Recorded, Declared, NotApplicable, Unsupported and Missing values. Split native table tests compare the full result. Startup references 1/129 remain exact. Intermediate per-page Missing values are removed transport. |

The fixed 128 grouping, page/copy counts, split 9999/1 ranges, fragment adjacency,
and zero page-size rejection belong only to the removed private pager API.
The approved complete-relation design has no such API. The sparse/empty tests
preserve the complete range and declared expected count. Final incomplete
coverage is GAPPED, as the old final computation required. Raw intermediate
page preservation of CLOSED is not a final-result contract.

PAGES.md maps all ten old page tests. ATOMS.md maps all eight old atom tests.

empty semantics. The two integrated source tests preserve the remaining exact
durable projection and unchanged-source/context-content revision assertions.

assertion in these two pure test leaves was found to be weaker.

lines from remaining Back roots. Back is inactive reference source, and all
